messages:
SRE-Bot: Alert detected: 18 hosts in eu-west2 reporting NVMe wear escalation + increased media errors. Marking as 'provisioning-hold' for GPU attach.
Maria: Wow — 18 hosts? what's the common signature? :eyes:
SRE-Bot: Common: SMART attr 231 (wear_leveling) rising, io_retries up, scrub backlog increasing. Example log: ```nvme0: I/O error, status: 0x200204, retry=4; smart: wear 82% -> 89% over 48h```
Kai: Are these all the same SKU/firmware? canary vs fleet split?
Andy: All r5g-nvme-4k equivalent boxes, fw v3.1.2. Canary (4 hosts) started first and now bleed to a broader pool after scrub ramp yesterday.
Jordan: Any immediate customer impact visible? GPU attach failures or slow attaches?
Maria: We already have 7 delayed GPU attachments (15-30s) flagged in apiserver traces; two allocation retries hit attach-timeouts and fell back to smaller machines.
Kai: For mitigation: 1) stop aggressive janitor scrubs on those hosts 2) set scrub concurrency to 1 for eu-west2 3) temporarily drain new GPU allocations away from that scratchpool. Thoughts?
Andy: +1. Also propose forcing fallback routing for non-critical batch jobs to us-west until health is restored. That buys margin.
Jordan: How about an automated pod-level throttle? We could flip a feature-flag to reduce background GC window.
Maria: Who can run scrub-tune now? I can if Andy wants to handle the routing changes.
Andy: I'll add a temporary pool tag `avoid-attach-eu-west2-nvme` and update the allocator policy, and add a canary to route 10% of traffic to fallback.
SRE-Bot: runbook note appended: `nvme-wear-escalation` -> throttle-scrub, drain-attach, route-fallback, escalate to Hardware Ops if SMART > 95%.
Kai: Also log correlation: network tail latencies spiked ~same time — could be compounding factor for retry storms. Check NPU offload queue metrics.
Maria: Command I ran: ```for h in $(cat hosts); do ssh $h 'nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0 | grep -E "wear|media_error"'; done``` saw repeated media_error_count increments.
Jordan: Okay plan: Andy does pool tag + allocator change (T+5m). Maria reduces scrub concurrency (T+10m). Kai monitors SMART deltas and posts an update in 30m. If hosts hit 95% wear -> we schedule replacements.
Andy: Starting pool tag now. Updating allocator policy... done :thumbsup:
Maria: Reducing janitor scrub concurrency to 1 for eu-west2... done.
Kai: Monitoring dashboards -> wear delta rate halved after changes. I see 2 hosts still trending fast, opening HW ops ticket to investigate firmware rollback possibility.
SRE-Bot: Incident note: severity=low->medium, impact=gpu-attach-delay, current-mitigation=pool-avoid + scrub-throttle.
Jordan: Thanks all. Keep posting short status updates. If attach failures increase we escalate to incident channel.
Andy: FYI I scheduled incremental replacements for the 2 worst hosts for next maintenance window.
Maria: will follow up with a short postmortem blurb once we have full SMART history.
Kai: Good work. :heavy_check_mark:
SRE-Bot: Auto-archive in 7 days unless `keep` flagged.
